bullets.text: AI Agents Made Easy - Microsoft introduces a real-world example of AI agents using the **Microsoft Agent Framework** and **Foundry**.
Frontier Suite Launch - **Microsoft 365 E7** and **Agent 365** set to transform business with AI and trust.
Secure AI Governance - **Agent 365** provides a unified control plane for managing AI agents securely.
Boosting Developer Productivity - **Microsoft Foundry** shows a 327% ROI through enhanced developer efficiency.
AI Threat Landscape - Threat actors are increasingly using AI to enhance cyberattack strategies.
Phishing Kit Insights - **Tycoon2FA** emerges as a leading phishing-as-a-service platform, bypassing MFA.
New Copilot Features - The **Copilot App** now opens web links in a sidepane for better context management.
Empowering Women in Cybersecurity - Celebrating women's contributions and encouraging diversity in the field.
Malicious Extensions Alert - **Microsoft Defender** warns about harmful browser extensions harvesting sensitive data.
Introducing GPT-5.4 - **Microsoft Foundry** now features GPT-5.4 for enhanced AI-driven workflows.
